description: This C# source file defines an abstract class 'ConsistencyTransactionTestRunner' within the Orleans.Transactions.TestKit namespace. The class provides functionality to run randomized consistency tests involving transactional operations, including handling concurrency, deadlocks, timeouts, and consistency verification for Orleans transactions. It utilizes asynchronous methods, external testing libraries like FluentAssertions, and references other components such as 'TransactionTestRunnerBase' and 'ConsistencyTestHarness'.

classes.name: ConsistencyTransactionTestRunner
classes.description: An abstract class for running consistency-related transaction tests in the Orleans framework. Provides a method to execute randomized consistency tests with configurable parameters about deadlocks, timeouts, and read/write behavior.

methods.name: RandomizedConsistency
methods.description: Executes a randomized consistency test involving multiple transaction sequences across grains, validating overall transaction consistency and handling different configurations related to deadlocks, timeouts, and error injection.
